naming_conventions.functions: simple verbs (get, set, delete, update, select, insert)
naming_conventions.rationale: Namespace provides context, function name stays simple

function_parameters.rationale: explicit over implicit - prevents arbitrary usage patterns
function_parameters.required: def func(a, b, c) - all parameters explicit and required

entity_autonomy.principle: Ogni entità applicativa del modulo deve essere autonoma e minimamente accoppiata
entity_autonomy.definition: Un'entità è un insieme coeso di file (model, service, repository, adapter) che gestisce una specifica risorsa del dominio
rules: Ogni entità ha il proprio file model con la propria funzione response()
Nessun response_model.py centralizzato condiviso tra entità
Service di un'entità importa solo il model della propria entità
Cross-entity references solo quando strettamente necessario
entity_autonomy.rationale: Minimo accoppiamento, massima coesione, facilità di manutenzione e testing

calls: entity_model.response(err, log, out) - for response wrapping

import_patterns.services: from ..adapters import contatto_adapter; from ..repositories import contatto_repository; from ..models import contatto_model

entity_isolation.rule: ogni service importa solo il model della propria entità

data_flow.response: data source -> (adapters | repositories) -> services (validate via entity_model) -> services (wrap via entity_model.response) -> routes (JSONResponse)

example.function: def response(err: bool, log: str | None, out: Any | None) -> dict: ...

forbidden_patterns.circular_imports: no adapter importing service, no model importing adapter, no repository importing service
forbidden_patterns.direct_access_from_routes: routes must never import adapters or repositories directly
forbidden_patterns.bypassing_response_function: services must never return raw data without entity_model.response()
forbidden_patterns.centralized_response_model: no models/response_model.py shared across entities - each entity has its own response()
forbidden_patterns.cross_entity_model_import: services should not import models from other entities unless strictly necessary
forbidden_patterns.verbose_function_names: no get_user_by_id, find_by_email, save_user - use simple verbs with parameters
forbidden_patterns.connection_management_in_repository: repositories must never manage DB connections, only receive DB instance
